digest.component_or_area: optional dependency plumbing and runtime availability guard
propositions: s3 optional dependency must be declared in pyproject.toml as s3 = ["git-remote-s3>=0.3.2"] and never installed by default
require_s3_helper() must verify both that the git-remote-s3 console script exists on PATH and the distribution version meets 0.3.2 minimum
require_s3_helper() must raise OptionalDependencyError with actionable install hint when either the console script is missing, distribution metadata is absent, or version is too old or unparseable
Version comparison must parse semantic versions into tuples of leading numeric components and fail closed on unparseable input without using packaging library
guard_import() with extra="s3" must produce standard one-line install message containing exact string "pip install 'nava-rebar[s3]'" when module is absent
_optional.py must remain stdlib-only with no imports from packaging or git_remote_s3 package
